words.example: Report a lost access card straight away so it can be blocked.
words.exampleZh: 门禁卡丢了要马上报告，以便及时停用。

words.example: A visitor pass must be worn and handed back at the lobby desk.
words.exampleZh: 访客证必须佩戴，并在大厅服务台交还。

words.example: Children visiting alone still need an escort to the ward.
words.exampleZh: 独自来的儿童探视，仍需要陪同送到病区。

words.example: Please wait in the lobby until someone comes down to collect you.
words.exampleZh: 请在大厅等候，直到有人下来接你。

words.example: The conference room screen is faulty, so bring paper copies.
words.exampleZh: 会议室的屏幕有故障，请带纸质材料。

words.example: The service bus dropped the link between orders and pharmacy at midnight.
words.exampleZh: 午夜时，服务总线把医嘱和药房之间的连接弄丢了。

words.example: Uptime for the lab interface is three days since the last restart.
words.exampleZh: 检验接口的可用时长，是上次重启以来的三天。

words.example: Downtime for outpatient registration was twenty-two minutes this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上门诊挂号的停机时长是二十二分钟。

words.example: The SLA clock for this lab outage has already passed forty minutes.
words.exampleZh: 这次检验停机的服务时限已经过了四十分钟。

words.example: The P1 incident on pharmacy dispensing has stayed open since last night.
words.exampleZh: 药房发药的一级故障从昨晚起一直没有关闭。
